_purpose: ROI + HSV thresholds for the benefits-phase box color detector (benefits.py).
_note: Coordinates are in the 640x480 C920 frame. Missing keys fall back to DEFAULT_CFG in benefits.py.

_fields.roi_x1/roi_y1/roi_x2/roi_y2: rectangle of the frame that is inspected
_fields.red_h_lo1/red_h_hi1: low red hue band (red wraps the hue circle)
_fields.min_pct: min percent of ROI a color must fill to be reported
